result.title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
result.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the Findings Track of the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) Symposium 2026
result.summary: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 attribution 驱动的医学影像数据整理拆成异常检测、危害估计与干预效用三项可检验主张，在 3D CT 血管造影分类器上做患者不重叠审计，定位 232 个全零数组并用五个配对种子检验删除后的 AUC 变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以 GradCAM++ 空间集中度和多 attribution 方法的排序不一致来筛证据、并用配对干预实验核查因果效用，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配的可信度评估提供核查线索，但研究对象是分类数据整理而非 latent 推理。
